== Lore ==
{{Legendary unlock text|This powerful soldier's armor pulses with [[The Mists|Mist]] energy. When you wear it on the upper floor of [[Stonemist Castle]], sometimes your chest aches with pride and agony.}}

== Acquisition ==
=== Sold by ===
* In order to be able to purchase the {{rarity|ascended|ascended}} piece, the equivalent [[Triumphant Hero's armor]] [[Triumphant Hero's Pauldrons|piece]] must have been unlocked. Additionally, a [[WvW Rank#World ranks|WvW ranking]] of 500 is required.
{{Sold by|id = 81375}}

{{Contained in}}
